messages:
ops-bot: [ALERT] hosted-usw2 GPU pool p95 queue latency > 1.8s; admission_rate=100%; auto-scaler_skipped=true
joel: noticing sustained queueing in hosted-usw2 since ~02:10. p95 token wait climbing, many admission rejects. KV cache hit rate down to 28%.
samira: on it. Are there any recent model deploys that would spike seq len?
ingrid: model-team pushed a coupling change at 02:14 but they rolled back at 02:22. logs still show high tail latencies.
joel: logs: proxy retries + admission rejects. example: 
```
admission:reject reason=capacity_ramp queue_ms=2400 cache_hit=false model=m-gen-3
```

nina: dashboards -> /dashboards/pool_capacity/hosted-usw2 shows slot_util=97%, enqueue_ms p95=2400, burst_tokens=0. autoscaler emitted a scale decision but failed due to quota error.
samira: if quota error is blocking scale, we need a short mitigation. Can we soft-burst (best-effort) or reroute non-prod traffic to euw1?
joel: don't want to break SLAs for paid customers. Proposal: 10% non-prod reroute + enable soft-burst for non-prod namespaces for 20m. command to enable soft-burst (dry run):
```
kubectl annotate pool/hosted-usw2 infra.redwood/allow-soft-burst="true" --context=infra
```
carl: started a canary reroute for non-prod: 10% traffic -> euw1. monitoring now.
ops-bot: log snippet from proxy: "admission:reject reason=capacity_ramp; client=svc-nonprod; retries=3"
nina: p95 dropped to ~1.1s after reroute kicked in, slot_util ~92% (still high).
samira: doing cache eviction to free KV memory for active sessions:
```
infractl cache evict --pool=hosted-usw2 --older-than=30m --dry-run=false
```
joel: started eviction job. also opened infra ticket for emergency burst capacity bump (infra-ops ticket created). tagging @oncall-eng-sre.
ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-1492; priority=high; owners=eng-infra,oncall-eng-sre
samira: runbook for next 30m: 1) keep 10% reroute for non-prod 2) enable soft-burst for 20m 3) run cache eviction 4) escalate quota request for autoscaler 5) watch egress costs for reroute
joel: ack. note: reroute increases cross-region egress — watch billing alerts. :thumbsup:
carl: monitoring shows drop in queue_ms for non-prod, but paid-prod still near p95=1.6s. will keep watching and follow up with model-team for request shape regression.
samira: I'll post a short incident note once metrics stabilize. adding cost estimate to ticket.
joel: thanks everyone. if p95 doesn't settle in next 30m we'll start scheduled spillover for low-tier customers.
samira: added postmortem stub in INC-2026-1492 and assigned to joel/carl for follow-up.
joel: closing thread here for now, will update INC-2026-1492.
